messages.author: 4e5a6b7a2e8b706a
messages.subject: FMI calculation
parts: I'd like to know how lavaan calculates the optional FMI (fraction of missing information).  The cited reference by Savalei & Rhemtulla has both a scalar formula for single parameters and a matrix formula for multiple parameters.  I presume that lavaan is using the matrix version, but I just want to verify that.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: FMI calculation
parts: I presume that lavaan is using the matrix version, but I just want to verify that.

No, lavaan uses the scalar version (less computational overhead):  https://github.com/yrosseel/lavaan/blob/master/R/lav_object_methods.R#L690

I think the matrix formula could be particularly handy when we want a single FMI to quantify the loss of information about a set of parameters (using determinants?), but I have never encountered anyone asking for that.
